_comment: Expected gateway config for a public Control UI behind a Nebula tunnel.
Merge these keys into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json — do not replace the whole file.
Replace <workspace>-<id> with your own hostname. Never commit a real one.

gateway._bind: REQUIRED. Loopback-only cannot be reached through the tunnel.

auth._mode: Shared-secret token auth. The token goes in the URL fragment, not the query string.

gateway._trustedProxies: cloudflared connects from localhost. Without this the gateway loses the client address and pairing approval shows the wrong IP.
gateway._publicOrigin: Set by the platform. Must match the hostname you browse to, or the gateway rejects the origin.

_tunnel_ingress_reference._note: This lives in /etc/cloudflared/config.yml, NOT in openclaw.json. Shown here for reference only.

ingress._comment: Catch-all. Unknown hostnames get 404 instead of routing somewhere unexpected.

_how_to_apply: 7. kill -USR1 "$(pgrep -f openclaw-gateway | head -1)"   # reload, never restart
9. openclaw devices list                # approve the pending browser pairing

_do_not_add.allowedOrigins: Not needed when publicOrigin matches. Only add on an explicit origin error. A 401 means the origin was already accepted and only credentials are missing.
